C1522.title: Euler Finance Hacker Receives On-Chain Phishing Message to Create Confusion
C1522.summary: After Euler Finance was attacked in March 2023, the attacker used on-chain messages to communicate with the project. SlowMist and related security material use the incident to explain both the role and the risk of on-chain messaging during incident response: attackers, projects, and third parties may all use on-chain messages to transmit information, and victims need to verify message sources and guard against secondary phishing through such messages.
